name: gavel
description: An RFQ desk on Hedera: takers escrow swap orders, market makers answer with EIP-712 quotes on a Hedera Consensus Service topic, the best quote settles through HTS allowances inside a Chainlink band, and an order nobody fills is swapped on SaucerSwap V2 by its own Schedule Service call.

steps.text: GavelDesk escrows swap orders, settles the best maker quote from a Hedera Consensus Service topic, and books a SaucerSwap V2 fallback for every order with the Hedera Schedule Service. Contracts run against Hedera testnet; there is no local chain step.

steps.label: Install the Foundry build Hashio accepts (Foundry 1.8 is rejected, hiero-json-rpc-relay#5826)
Put its key in packages/foundry/.env as DEPLOYER_PRIVATE_KEY, then deploy and run every flow on testnet

steps.text: README.md walks through the design; AGENTS.md briefs coding agents.
